{{recipe}}

A classic '''apple pie''' is a double-crusted [[Cookbook:Pie|pie]] filled with sweetened and spiced apples. The exact spices vary by recipe, but cinnamon is traditional.

== Ingredients ==

=== '''Dough''' ===
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 8 ounces cold [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], cut into ½-inch pieces
* 5–7 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] applejack (apple [[Cookbook:Brandy|brandy]]) or hard [[Cookbook:Cider|cider]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] table [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp sugar

=== '''Filling''' ===
* 6 Honeycrisp [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled, cored, and cut into 12ths
* ½ cup granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]], divided
* ¼ tsp salt
* ¼ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Grains of Paradise|grains of paradise]]
* ¾ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] apple [[Cookbook:Jelly|jelly]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Apple Cider|apple cider]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Tapioca Starch|tapioca starch]] 
* 2 tsp freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine dough ingredients to get a mealy dough. Split in half by weight, shape into 2 disks, and chill for 1 hour.
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] apples with ¼ cup sugar and place in a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]] set over a large bowl. Let drain for 1 ½ hours.
#Transfer liquid from bowl into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium high heat. Cook until reduced to 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]]. Set aside.
#Toss apples with remaining filling ingredients. Set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] both disks of crust into rough circles. Place one inside a 9 ½–10-inch [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|tart pan]] and attach.
#Add apples to the crust in a concentric circle, starting from the outside and working to the inside, making the center slightly taller than the outside. Pour any liquid in the bottom of the bowl over the apples.
#Top with the second sheet of dough, and seal the edges. [[Cookbook:Pie Crust Edges|Crimp the edges]] if desired, then snip 3 incisions in the center. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] top with reduced apple liquid.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 425°F on the floor of the oven in a half sheet pan lined with parchment for 30 minutes. Transfer to the lower rack, and bake for another 20 minutes.
#Remove and cool for 4 hours. Serve.

steps.text: Combine dough ingredients to get a mealy dough. Split in half by weight, shape into 2 disks, and chill for 1 hour.
Toss apples with ¼ cup sugar and place in a colander set over a large bowl. Let drain for 1 ½ hours.
Transfer liquid from bowl into a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cook until reduced to 2 tbsp. Set aside.
Toss apples with remaining filling ingredients. Set aside.
Roll out both disks of crust into rough circles. Place one inside a 9 ½–10-inch tart pan and attach.

Add apples to the crust in a concentric circle, starting from the outside and working to the inside, making the center slightly taller than the outside. Pour any liquid in the bottom of the bowl over the apples.
Top with the second sheet of dough, and seal the edges. Crimp the edges if desired, then snip 3 incisions in the center. Brush top with reduced apple liquid.
Bake at 425°F on the floor of the oven in a half sheet pan lined with parchment for 30 minutes. Transfer to the lower rack, and bake for another 20 minutes.
Remove and cool for 4 hours. Serve.
